title: Site Structure & Knowledge Updates | BHOC Veterinary
description: Dated BHOC Veterinary site and scientific catalogue updates, including comparative oxygen transport, microcirculation and animal-model research.
heading: Site Structure & Knowledge Updates
lead: Significant changes to scientific resources and site content. Routine maintenance is not listed.

entries.title: Cat cities and islands: illustrated animal-welfare story added
entries.text: Added ten place-specific stories, including the Hermitage cats, with real photographs, dated population figures, local care organisations and source links. The article is linked from Stories That Matter, Initiative and Veterinary News.

entries.title: TRACS veterinary transfusion-safety evidence note added
entries.text: Added a 20-point source-linked note on TRACS Part 2, with a separate BHOC research question and a short Veterinary News announcement.

entries.title: Open call for CRADA-model research partnerships
entries.text: Added the BHOC joint research invitation with the approved wide banner, eight research areas, contact details and links to veterinary science and the Initiative.

entries.title: COP17 species recovery news and Initiative perspective added
entries.text: A source-linked news article covers CARES and the Species Recovery Alliance, with a separate BHOC Initiative perspective on veterinary care and wildlife rescue. The original publication graphic has responsive WebP versions and visible source attribution.

links.label: Read the COP17 species recovery article

entries.title: Veterinary evidence navigation unified
entries.text: The central Vet Real-World Evidence & Cases index and BHOC Veterinary Science now use the same three primary routes: Vet Related Scientific Evidence, Vet Real-World Evidence & Cases and Vet Research Questions. Vet Concepts & Questions remains separate within the research layer.

entries.title: Comparative oxygen transport and animal-model research added
entries.text: Seven animal-study publications added to the shared veterinary search, now 267 records. Science links these studies and Vadapalli, Goldman & Popel (2002). The 30-paper review added 27 new publications across six research directions: studies comparing red blood cells and extracellular hemoglobin carriers by actual oxygen transport, rather than hemoglobin concentration alone.

entries.title: Five oxygenation and microcirculation research publications added
entries.text: Relevant shared research: five Dyson/Singer studies were added to the BHOC Oxygen Diffusion & Microcirculation catalogue, providing background on tissue oxygenation, shock and organ perfusion. The studies are not veterinary BHOC efficacy data. The Oxygen Diffusion & Microcirculation catalogue now lists 215 records; the five BHOC Evidence Library collections contain 923 placements in total.
